subject: Economic buyer & budget owner follow-up - Waverly Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Green <emma@waverlyanalytics.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@waverlyanalytics.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation

Hi Emma — thanks again for the intro and the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned:

- Goal: 2–3 week pilot to validate latency/cost and evaluate quality on your customer support workload.
- Success criteria (per our call): 95th percentile latency < 300ms for short prompts, monthly cost target <$0.01/token equivalent, and no regression on key intent extraction tests.
- Ask from Waverly: intro to the person who owns budget (economic buyer) + procurement steps/security contacts for SOC2/Audit evidence.

Open items / next steps:
1) Emma to introduce the budget owner and procurement lead (who will own contract & PO).
2) Redwood will send a short POC plan, ballpark pricing, and a link to our security overview and SOC2 report.
3) Schedule a 30-min alignment call next week with the budget owner + engineering.

I attached the trial details doc and a short POC template — happy to tailor.

Attachments: redwood-trial-details.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Emma Green <emma@waverlyanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@waverlyanalytics.com>, procurement@waverlyanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation

Hi Marissa — great to meet you on the call. Looping in procurement and suggesting the person who owns budget for this initiative: Sophie Adler (cc’d). Sophie runs GTM ops and owns third-party tooling spend for the product org.

Sophie — short intro: Redwood Inference provides low-latency LLM inference; we discussed a 2–3 week pilot to validate costs and latency vs our current provider. Can you advise on Waverly’s procurement process and whether we need an initial ballpark estimate to get internal approval?

Procurement team — please advise on standard PO/contract timelines and any checklist items you need (security/attestations).

Thanks,
Emma Green
Head of Product Insights | Waverly Analytics
emma@waverlyanalytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Adler <sophie.adler@waverlyanalytics.com>, Emma Green <emma@waverlyanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation

Thanks Emma & Sophie — Sophie, great to meet you. Short reply with what we can provide to move this forward:

- Ballpark pricing: for a 3-week pilot sized against ~2M tokens of mixed prompts, estimate ~$8k–$12k (depends on batching & KV cache) — we can tighten after we see token profile.
- POC plan: 2-week pilot + 1 week for validation and decision. We’ll provide an isolated sandbox environment, monitoring dashboard, and an SSO-enabled test account.
- Security docs: SOC 2 Type II report, data retention details, and artifact list — happy to share via a secure link (or sign an NDA if required).

Attached: redwood-pricing-ballpark.xlsx (ballpark numbers)

Proposed next step: 30-min intro call next Tue or Wed with Sophie + your procurement lead and Daniel (if he’s the budget owner). Please suggest availability.

If it helps, I can also send a short one-page commercial summary for your finance team.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood-pricing-ballpark.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation

Internal — quick note on pricing flexibility: for a first-time pilot with a likely enterprise opportunity, we can approve up to a 20% one-time pilot discount and include a free 30-day extended trial environment. Recommend we offer: 15% off the ballpark estimate + standard 30-day pilot credits; hold anything larger until we have an intro to the VP of Finance/budget owner.

If Marissa agrees, go ahead and include that in the summary email to Sophie/Daniel.

— Rishi
VP Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Adler <sophie.adler@waverlyanalytics.com>, Emma Green <emma@waverlyanalytics.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@waverlyanalytics.com>, procurement@waverlyanalytics.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation

Sophie/Emma/Daniel — thanks for the quick responses and for the intro, Sophie. Daniel — nice to e-meet you. Per Sophie, Daniel is the VP of Finance and will own budget/approval for this engagement.

Summary & ask:
- Pilot scope: 2-week integrated pilot (support prompts, KV caching enabled) + 1 week for validation.
- Pilot price (after pilot discount): $8,500 (Marissa note: ballpark estimate $10k with 15% pilot discount applied).
- What we need from Waverly: procurement contact to accept a pilot SOW and PO (cc’d procurement@waverlyanalytics.com), and a security contact to receive our SOC2 and data handling doc.

Next steps we can drive right now:
1) I’ll send a short SOW draft and a one-page commercial summary (attaching SOW-draft.pdf).
2) Rishi has approved a 15% pilot discount and 30-day trial credits.
3) Can we schedule a 30-minute alignment call next Tue 12/15 at 10:00am ET to review the SOW and procurement timeline? If that doesn’t work, please propose two alternatives.

If procurement prefers, I can send the SOW via DocuSign or upload to your procurement portal — let me know the preferred route.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf
